title: 山陽新幹線~Sanyo Shinkansen
focus: 山岳高速線隧道壓力與橋隧連續性~Mountain high speed tunnel pressure and bridge continuity
summary: 以山陽新幹線的跨區域高速運輸為背景，建立連續隧道、橋梁與車站的假想剖面。學徒把列車進洞壓力、受電品質與排水維修放在同一系統邊界，分析短隧道間露天段是否改變乘坐舒適與維修需求。~Use the Sanyo high-speed corridor as the setting for an invented profile containing successive tunnels, bridges and stations. Place entry pressure, current collection and drainage maintenance inside one system boundary. Investigate how a short open section between tunnels can alter pressure exposure, track behaviour and access requirements without treating a simplified pressure estimate as a tunnel certification calculation.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 travel=7.794118 s；單元 2 得 density=0.7914385 kg/m^3；單元 3 得 displacement_flow=190.8 m^3/s。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 length 的擾動測試，結果改為 8.573529 s；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以山陽新幹線的跨區域高速運輸為背景，建立連續隧道、橋梁與車站的假想剖面。學徒把列車進洞壓力、受電品質與排水維修放在同一系統邊界，分析短隧道間露天段是否改變乘坐舒適與維修需求。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives travel=7.794118 s; unit 2 gives density=0.7914385 kg/m^3; unit 3 gives displacement_flow=190.8 m^3/s. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing length in the first unit changes its result to 8.573529 s. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Sanyo high-speed corridor as the setting for an invented profile containing successive tunnels, bridges and stations. Place entry pressure, current collection and drainage maintenance inside one system boundary. Investigate how a short open section between tunnels can alter pressure exposure, track behaviour and access requirements without treating a simplified pressure estimate as a tunnel certification calculation. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：1972 年：山陽新幹線新大阪至岡山區間開通；1975 年：山陽新幹線延伸至博多完成當時全線。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以山陽新幹線的跨區域高速運輸為背景，建立連續隧道、橋梁與車站的假想剖面。學徒把列車進洞壓力、受電品質與排水維修放在同一系統邊界，分析短隧道間露天段是否改變乘坐舒適與維修需求。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 1972: The Shin-Osaka to Okayama section of the Sanyo Shinkansen opened; 1975: The Sanyo Shinkansen extension to Hakata completed the route. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Sanyo high-speed corridor as the setting for an invented profile containing successive tunnels, bridges and stations. Place entry pressure, current collection and drainage maintenance inside one system boundary. Investigate how a short open section between tunnels can alter pressure exposure, track behaviour and access requirements without treating a simplified pressure estimate as a tunnel certification calculation. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 隧道壓力波傳遞~Tunnel pressure-wave travel
units.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞~Tunnel pressure-wave travel
units.mechanism: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。入口緩衝設計影響波形上升率，波到達出口的時間與車身到達時間屬不同問題，須分開建立量測觸發。 波傳時間由傳播距離除以聲速決定，與列車走完整段的時間不同。此式只預測到達時序而不預測波幅；洞口形狀、列車頭型和反射決定的壓力變化須用其他流動模型。 在連續隧道與洞口測點之間比較聲波傳播時間和列車通過時間，另列波幅問題。~A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. Entrance treatments affect the rise of the waveform. Wave arrival and train arrival are different events and require separate measurement triggers. Wave travel time is propagation distance divided by sound speed, not the time for the train to traverse the section. This expression predicts arrival timing, not amplitude. Portal geometry, train-nose shape and reflections require additional flow models to predict pressure changes. Compare acoustic travel time with train-passage time between tunnel and portal sensors, treating wave amplitude as a separate problem.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.794118 s。敏感度：length 單獨增加百分之十至 2915 m，其餘固定，結果為 8.573529 s。模型邊界：一維線性聲學且音速均勻；不預測波幅、微壓波峰值或反射耗散。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.794118 s. Sensitivity: length, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2915 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.573529 s. Model boundary: One-dimensional linear acoustics with uniform sound speed; amplitude, micro-pressure-wave peaks and reflection losses are not predicted.
units.verify: 在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。 在洞口與洞內配置同步壓力測點，對照列車頭部通過時刻，分辨首波與後續反射。~Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately. Synchronise pressure sensors at the portal and inside the tunnel with nose-passage time, distinguishing the first wave from later reflections.
units.failure: 時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。 單點峰值不足以判別首波，須檢查測點間傳遞時差。~Timestamp error can imitate a wave-speed change, while reflected waves and multiple train events can make cross-correlation select the wrong peak. A single peak cannot identify the first wave; inspect propagation delay between sensors.
units.misconception: 隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口~A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train.
units.practice: 比較壓力波與列車兩種到達時間，加入一次端部反射畫出事件圖，說明單一延遲量無法判斷出口微壓波是否超標。 再以本單元 length 的對照值重算 travel，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare wave and train arrival times, add one end reflection to the event diagram, and explain why travel time alone cannot establish compliance of portal micro-pressure waves. Also recalculate travel for the alternative length value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 高海拔壓力與氣體密度~Altitude pressure and air density
units.title: 高海拔壓力與氣體密度~Altitude pressure and air density
units.mechanism: 理想氣體密度由絕對壓力除氣體常數與絕對溫度決定，高海拔低壓會減少同體積空氣所攜帶的質量。這同時影響散熱和氣動力，但車廂供氧與醫療需求不能由密度公式單獨決定。 此理想氣體式以絕對壓力和絕對溫度估算空氣密度，壓力不代表氧氣比例。高原環境的密度可影響氣動和冷卻估算，但人員生理與主動加壓系統需要另外分析。 以隧道內外溫度和絕對壓力估算空氣密度，另列壓力波模型。~Ideal-gas density is absolute pressure divided by gas constant and absolute temperature. Lower pressure at altitude reduces the mass carried in a fixed air volume, affecting cooling and aerodynamic loads. Cabin oxygen provision and medical needs cannot be determined by density alone. This ideal-gas expression estimates air density from absolute pressure and temperature; pressure is not an oxygen fraction. Altitude-dependent density can affect aerodynamic and cooling estimates, while human physiology and active pressurisation require separate analysis. Estimate air density from tunnel and outside temperature and absolute pressure, separately identifying the pressure-wave model.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：pressure=63600 Pa; Rair=287 J/(kg*K); temperature=280 K；計算：density=pressure/(Rair*temperature)=0.7914385 kg/m^3。敏感度：pressure 單獨增加百分之十至 69960 Pa，其餘固定，結果為 0.8705824 kg/m^3。模型邊界：乾空氣理想氣體、均勻壓溫；不計濕度與生理反應。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: pressure=63600 Pa; Rair=287 J/(kg*K); temperature=280 K; calculation: density=pressure/(Rair*temperature)=0.7914385 kg/m^3. Sensitivity: pressure, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 69960 Pa, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.8705824 kg/m^3. Model boundary: Dry ideal air at uniform pressure and temperature; humidity and physiological response are excluded.
units.verify: 使用絕對壓力計與校正溫度計，核對感測器是否誤報表壓，並用已知風量估算質量流率檢查冷卻設計假設。 校正絕對壓力計並量測同位置氣溫，核對溫標換算，必要時另列濕度造成的氣體性質差異。~Use absolute-pressure and calibrated temperature sensors, check that gauge pressure is not mistaken for absolute pressure, and compare mass flow inferred from measured volume flow. Calibrate the absolute-pressure sensor and measure temperature at the same location, checking the temperature conversion and separately considering humidity effects.
units.failure: 把攝氏溫度直接代入氣體公式會產生巨大誤差；低密度時沿用海平面風量又可能不足以移除同一熱負載。 若使用攝氏溫度直接作分母，空氣密度會失去正確物理意義。~Using Celsius directly in the gas equation creates a large error; at low density, sea-level volume flow may not remove the same heat load. Using Celsius temperature directly in the denominator produces a physically incorrect air density.
units.misconception: 空氣體積流率相同就表示任何海拔的散熱質量流率相同~Equal volumetric airflow guarantees equal cooling mass flow at every altitude.
units.practice: 比較兩種絕對壓力下的密度與同風量質量流率，標註溫標換算，再說明哪些車廂環境議題需要其他專業模型。 再以本單元 pressure 的對照值重算 density，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare density and mass flow at two absolute pressures, show temperature-scale conversion, and identify cabin-environment questions requiring additional specialised models. Also recalculate density for the alternative pressure value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 列車活塞流量與堵塞比~Train piston flow and blockage ratio
units.title: 列車活塞流量與堵塞比~Train piston flow and blockage ratio
units.mechanism: 列車進入受限斷面時排擠空氣，列車截面乘速度提供幾何排量的量級。實際空氣可經車旁間隙、通風井和相鄰隧道分流，因此幾何排量不是某一通風井的實測流量。 列車排開體積的模型首先遵守連續方程，但洩漏、車站開口與可壓縮效應會改變實際流場。應明確使用剩餘通流面積，不能用整個隧道面積忽略車體阻塞。 在隧道橫斷面中分開列車阻塞面積與剩餘通風面積。~A train displaces air in a confined section, and frontal area times speed gives the geometric displacement scale. Air divides through the annular gap, shafts and adjoining tunnels. Geometric displacement therefore does not equal measured flow through a particular ventilation shaft. A displaced-volume model first follows continuity, but leakage, station openings and compressibility alter the actual field. Use the remaining flow area explicitly rather than the whole tunnel area while ignoring train blockage. Separate train blockage area from the remaining ventilation area in a tunnel cross-section.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：train_area=9.54 m^2; speed=20 m/s；計算：displacement_flow=train_area*speed=190.8 m^3/s。敏感度：train_area 單獨增加百分之十至 10.494 m^2，其餘固定，結果為 209.88 m^3/s。模型邊界：不可壓縮幾何排量；未求壓差、流路分配與空氣壓縮。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: train_area=9.54 m^2; speed=20 m/s; calculation: displacement_flow=train_area*speed=190.8 m^3/s. Sensitivity: train_area, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 10.494 m^2, with all other inputs fixed, gives 209.88 m^3/s. Model boundary: Incompressible geometric displacement; pressure difference, path splitting and compressibility are not solved.
units.verify: 以列車位置同步觸發各風井和月台風速量測，檢查流量方向與時間差，避免把瞬時尖峰當成持續換氣能力。 在列車通過前後同步量測風速、壓力及位置，以多點截面平均避免局部噴流誤差。~Trigger shaft and platform air-velocity measurements from train position, inspect direction and delay, and avoid treating a brief peak as continuous ventilation capacity. Synchronise airflow, pressure and train position around passage, using a multipoint section average to avoid bias from local jets.
units.failure: 風井受阻時氣流可能轉移到月台，造成局部強風；單一風速計又可能量到回流區而低估主流。 局部風速尖峰不能當作整段平均流量，須核對截面分布。~A blocked shaft can redirect flow toward the platform and create local gusts; one anemometer inside a recirculation region may underestimate the main flow. A local velocity peak cannot represent whole-section flow; inspect the cross-sectional distribution.
units.misconception: 列車截面乘速度就是所有風井各自收到的相同流量~Train frontal area times speed is the identical flow received by every ventilation shaft.
units.practice: 將總排量分配到兩條假想阻力路徑，畫出質量守恆圖，再說明需要哪些壓差資料才能求分流比例。 再以本單元 train_area 的對照值重算 displacement_flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Divide the displacement among two hypothetical resistance paths, draw the mass balance, and identify the pressure measurements required to determine the split. Also recalculate displacement_flow for the alternative train_area value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 延遲與制動距離~Delay and braking distance
units.title: 延遲與制動距離~Delay and braking distance
units.mechanism: 列車在控制命令傳遞與煞車建立期間仍向前行駛，減速段才把動能耗散；因此停車距離包含延遲距離與減速距離。速度平方項說明高速時少量速度誤差會被放大，固定減速度只能作第一輪界限估算。 延遲項與速度成正比，減速項與速度平方成正比；把兩項分開後，才能選擇改善控制延遲或增加有效制動的方案。若存在坡度，應另加沿坡重力，不能只改總距離。 把隧道內制動後的位置與避難通道的里程分開標示。~A train continues moving while the command propagates and brake force builds. Only the deceleration phase removes kinetic energy, so stopping distance includes both a delay term and a braking term. The squared speed dependence amplifies speed uncertainty; constant deceleration is only an initial bounding approximation. The delay term is linear in speed and the deceleration term is quadratic. Separating them reveals whether control latency or effective braking deserves attention. A gradient requires an added gravitational component, not an arbitrary adjustment to the final distance. Mark the post-braking position and emergency-passage chainage separately inside a tunnel.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=74.2 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2；計算：distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=4118.1 m。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 81.62 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 4962.496 m。模型邊界：水平直線、定減速、無風；沒有建立黏著分布與煞車熱衰退。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=74.2 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2; calculation: distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=4118.1 m. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 81.62 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 4962.496 m. Model boundary: Level straight track and constant deceleration; adhesion variation and thermal fade are excluded.
units.verify: 對齊速度、煞車缸壓力與里程的時間戳，分開辨識命令延遲及穩態減速度，再以積分速度的距離交叉檢查。 用獨立里程或地速核對輪速積分，報告濕乾軌差異及停車距離的重複試驗範圍。~Align speed, brake-cylinder pressure and distance timestamps. Identify command delay separately from steady deceleration and cross-check distance by integrating measured speed. Check integrated wheel speed against independent distance or ground speed, and report wet-dry differences and repeated stopping-distance ranges.
units.failure: 輪滑保護介入與濕軌會降低實際減速度；感測時間不同步也能製造假延遲，須以第二個時鐘和輪速紀錄區分。 應比較壓力建立與地速下降先後，避免誤判煞車故障。~Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration; unsynchronised sensors can imitate a delay, requiring an independent clock and wheel-speed records. Compare pressure build-up with ground-speed decay before diagnosing a brake fault.
units.misconception: 速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成~A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent.
units.practice: 分別增加延遲與初速，畫出兩條停車曲線；寫出哪個區段對各參數敏感，以及需要哪些現場資料才可建立保護曲線。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase delay and initial speed separately, plot both stopping curves, identify the sensitive phase, and list the field evidence needed before defining a protection curve. Also recalculate distance for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度~Cant and unbalanced acceleration
units.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度~Cant and unbalanced acceleration
units.mechanism: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。超高平衡速度只對特定半徑和速度成立，慢車可能出現超高過剩；不能把增加超高當成所有車種都受益的措施。 殘餘加速度的正負表示側向作用方向，而不是安全與危險的二元判斷。半徑、軌距與高差必須使用一致長度單位，車體感受還會受到懸吊轉角影響。 比較洞口附近曲線的平衡速度與低速維修列車工況。~On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. Equilibrium cant applies to one radius and speed. A slower service can experience cant excess, so increasing cant does not improve every train condition. The sign of residual acceleration identifies its lateral direction, not a binary safe-unsafe outcome. Radius, gauge and rail-level difference require consistent length units. Carbody response is additionally affected by suspension rotation, which this geometric estimate does not resolve. Compare curve equilibrium speed near a portal with a slow maintenance-train condition.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 69.96 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.4388004 m/s^2。模型邊界：小角度近似與剛性車體；未計懸吊側滾、動態輪重減載和規範允收值。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 69.96 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.4388004 m/s^2. Model boundary: Small-angle approximation and rigid body; suspension roll, dynamic wheel unloading and acceptance limits are excluded.
units.verify: 在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。 用實測半徑和高差重算平衡速度，保留感測器安裝角的校正值及量測不確定度。~Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings. Recalculate equilibrium speed from measured radius and cant, retaining mounting-angle corrections and uncertainty for the acceleration sensor.
units.failure: 只依高速通過最佳化超高，可能讓慢車或停車承受反向側向力；感測器橫滾又會把重力投影混入振動訊號。 需核對高差符號與曲線方向，防止左右軌互換。~Cant optimised only for fast trains can impose reverse lateral loading on slow or stopped trains; sensor roll also mixes gravity into vibration measurements. Check cant sign against curve direction to prevent swapping the inner and outer rails.
units.misconception: 任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度~Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.
units.practice: 選兩種速度共同計算殘餘加速度，找出符號反轉位置，說明為何混合服務需要速度分布而非單一最高速度。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate residual acceleration for two speeds, locate its sign reversal, and explain why mixed services require a speed distribution rather than one maximum speed. Also recalculate residual for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度~Bridge deflection and span sensitivity
units.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度~Bridge deflection and span sensitivity
units.mechanism: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。鐵道橋還需要動態與軌道相互作用檢查，靜態梁算例只用來辨認參數量級。 跨長四次方使幾何誤差特別重要，但只有在相同支承、均布荷載及截面條件下才可比較。將毫米轉成公尺後再核對剛度，可避免把量測位移誤差變成材料性能判斷。 檢查短橋跨的靜態撓度並指出移動列車動力仍待分析。~For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. Section inertia and material stiffness jointly resist bending. A railway bridge also requires dynamic and track-interaction checks; this static beam exercise only reveals parameter magnitudes. Fourth-power span dependence makes geometry important, but comparison requires the same support, uniform-load and section assumptions. Convert millimetres and metres consistently before checking stiffness, so a displacement-unit error does not become a false conclusion about material properties. Check static deflection of a short bridge and identify the remaining moving-train dynamic analysis.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=26.5 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.146659 mm。敏感度：L 單獨增加百分之十至 29.15 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.678823 mm。模型邊界：簡支Euler梁、小撓度、靜態均布荷載；不代表列車移動荷載。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=26.5 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.146659 mm. Sensitivity: L, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 29.15 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.678823 mm. Model boundary: Simply supported Euler beam, small deflection and static uniform load; not a moving train-load analysis.
units.verify: 在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。 先以已知荷載校對位移計量程與零點，分別記錄載入卸載路徑及支點運動。~Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading. Check displacement-sensor range and zero under known loading, recording loading and unloading paths separately from support movement.
units.failure: 支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。 若卸載後仍有位移，須區分基座滑移與構件殘留變形。~Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus. Residual displacement after unloading requires distinguishing fixture slip from permanent structural deformation.
units.misconception: 橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成~Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
units.practice: 保持截面不變增加跨長，再比較提高慣性矩的補償幅度，說明靜態位移符合預期為何仍不能取代動態驗證。 再以本單元 L 的對照值重算 deflection，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase span while keeping the section fixed, calculate the compensating inertia change, and explain why agreement in static deflection cannot replace dynamic verification. Also recalculate deflection for the alternative L value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.mechanism: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。 相同端點坡度可以對應完全不同的中間形狀，因此坡度不能單獨表示軌道曲率。測點間距必須小於欲辨認的變形尺度，並將高程誤差相對於基長傳遞到坡度結果。 在路堤、橋台與隧道銜接處設計多點高程剖面。~Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak. A spatial profile is needed to identify curvature and deformation length. Identical endpoint gradient can hide very different intermediate shapes, so gradient alone cannot describe track curvature. Survey spacing must resolve the deformation length scale, and elevation uncertainty must be propagated relative to the baseline into the reported gradient. Design multipoint elevation profiles across embankment, abutment and tunnel transitions.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.013992 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.6996 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m. Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.013992 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.6996 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded.
units.verify: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。~Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline.
units.failure: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。~A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement.
units.misconception: 兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷~Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
units.practice: 構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 集水與排水容量~Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
units.title: 集水與排水容量~Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
units.mechanism: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。 合理化流量法假定雨強與集流條件相符，面積及逕流係數也須明確。它估算峰值流率而非完整洪水歷線；抽水或蓄水設計還需對時間積分和出口條件。 將洞口雨水與隧道滲水分為兩個入流來源。~A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level. Counting only track surface can omit inflow from adjacent slopes and station areas. The rational estimate assumes rainfall intensity compatible with catchment response and explicit area and runoff coefficient. It gives a peak rate, not a complete hydrograph. Pumping or storage design additionally requires time integration and outlet conditions. Separate portal runoff and tunnel seepage into two inflow sources.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.12e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.32436 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.332e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.356796 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.12e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.32436 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.332e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.356796 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded.
units.verify: 現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。 核對雨量單位和有效集水邊界，量測泵浦出流與集水井水位變化，以體積守恆互證。~Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater. Verify rainfall units and catchment boundaries, measure pump outflow and sump-level change, and cross-check them through volume conservation.
units.failure: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 排水堵塞改變有效出流，不能只用較大泵浦銘牌值補償。~Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Blocked drainage changes effective outflow and cannot be compensated merely by a larger pump nameplate rating.
units.misconception: 排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位~A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
units.practice: 將部分入口視為堵塞，建立地表暫存與排出的水量表；比較增加入口和增加泵量對不同瓶頸的效果。 再以本單元 rain 的對照值重算 flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Block selected inlets in the scenario, tabulate surface storage and discharge, and compare additional inlets with additional pumping for different bottlenecks. Also recalculate flow for the alternative rain value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 接觸線張力波速~Contact-wire tension wave speed
units.title: 接觸線張力波速~Contact-wire tension wave speed
units.mechanism: 受電弓擾動會沿接觸線傳播，張力提高使橫波速度上升而線密度增加使波速下降。波速與列車速度的比值提供動態風險線索，但多跨懸掛、吊弦和接觸非線性不能由單根弦模型取代。 線密度決定單位長度的慣性，張力提供恢復作用，因此波速平方與張力成正比。提高張力也改變支承受力；波速裕度只能作篩檢，不能推定接觸力必然均勻。 比較露天和隧道內支承條件改變時的架線動態。~Pantograph disturbances propagate along the contact wire. Greater tension raises transverse wave speed, whereas greater mass per length lowers it. The ratio to train speed offers a dynamic clue, but multispan suspension, droppers and contact nonlinearity cannot be replaced by a single-string model. Linear density represents inertia per unit length and tension supplies restoring force, so squared wave speed scales with tension. Higher tension also changes support loading. A wave-speed margin is a screening measure, not proof of uniform contact force. Compare contact-line dynamics when support conditions change between open track and tunnel.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：tension=21200 N; density=1.1 kg/m；計算：wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=138.8262 m/s。敏感度：tension 單獨增加百分之十至 23320 N，其餘固定，結果為 145.6022 m/s。模型邊界：無彎曲剛度的均勻張弦；不是受流合格判定或允許車速。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: tension=21200 N; density=1.1 kg/m; calculation: wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=138.8262 m/s. Sensitivity: tension, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 23320 N, with all other inputs fixed, gives 145.6022 m/s. Model boundary: Uniform tensioned string without bending stiffness; not a current-collection acceptance rule or permitted train speed.
units.verify: 核對補償裝置行程、線溫與張力紀錄，再量測受電弓接觸力統計及離線事件，辨別平均值正常但峰值異常。 核對接觸線張力、單位長度質量及量測位置，並用接觸力和離線事件檢查動態品質。~Check compensation travel, wire temperature and tension, then examine contact-force statistics and loss-of-contact events to distinguish acceptable means from abnormal peaks. Verify contact-wire tension, mass per unit length and measurement location, then examine contact force and loss-of-contact events for dynamic quality.
units.failure: 補償裝置卡滯會讓溫度變化改變張力，吊弦鬆弛又會改變局部動態剛度；只讀取靜態高度難以辨識。 波速符合估算仍可能離線，需查看接觸力的時間歷程。~A sticking tensioning device lets temperature change tension, while slack droppers change local dynamic stiffness; static wire height alone cannot identify either mechanism. Agreement in wave-speed estimates does not rule out contact loss; inspect contact-force histories.
units.misconception: 只要靜態接觸線高度正確就能保證高速受流品質~Correct static contact-wire height alone guarantees good current collection at high speed.
units.practice: 將張力降低一成和線密度增加一成分別計算波速，列出尚需哪些接觸力量測才能討論動態受流品質。 再以本單元 tension 的對照值重算 wave_speed，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Reduce tension and increase wire mass density separately by ten percent, calculate wave speed, and identify the contact-force measurements still needed to assess dynamic collection. Also recalculate wave_speed for the alternative tension value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 煞車熱量與溫升~Brake heat and temperature rise
units.title: 煞車熱量與溫升~Brake heat and temperature rise
units.mechanism: 未回收的動能會在摩擦煞車與阻力路徑中轉成熱，平均溫升由分配到構件的能量除以熱容量決定。短時平均模型無法描述表面熱點、對流冷卻或熱裂紋，需要把能量分配與熱擴散分開。 有效受熱質量可以小於構件總質量，短時接觸表面的熱量也未必已傳到內部。能量平衡應先界定摩擦分配比例，再評估對流、輻射和間歇冷卻是否可忽略。 在連續減速情境下區分單次熱量與尚未散去的殘熱。~Unrecovered kinetic energy becomes heat through friction brakes and resistance paths. Average temperature rise is allocated energy divided by thermal capacity. A short-duration lumped model cannot describe surface hot spots, cooling or thermal cracks; energy allocation and thermal diffusion are separate questions. The effective heated mass can be smaller than total component mass, and short-duration surface heat may not reach the interior. First define frictional energy allocation, then assess whether convection, radiation and cooling between events can be neglected. Distinguish one braking event’s heat from residual heat during repeated deceleration.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=1.272e+07 J; mass=220 kg; cp=460 J/(kg*K)；計算：rise=energy/(mass*cp)=125.6917 K。敏感度：energy 單獨增加百分之十至 1.3992e+07 J，其餘固定，結果為 138.2609 K。模型邊界：均勻溫度且無散熱、常數比熱；不推定摩擦材極限。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=1.272e+07 J; mass=220 kg; cp=460 J/(kg*K); calculation: rise=energy/(mass*cp)=125.6917 K. Sensitivity: energy, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1.3992e+07 J, with all other inputs fixed, gives 138.2609 K. Model boundary: Uniform temperature without heat loss and with constant heat capacity; no friction-material limit is inferred.
units.verify: 以熱電偶與紅外量測交叉檢查溫升，記錄煞車能量、環境溫度與冷卻時間，並校正紅外放射率。 在不同深度保留溫度曲線並核對感測器反應時間，用初末能量平衡檢查平均溫升。~Cross-check temperature rise with thermocouples and infrared measurements, record braking energy, ambient temperature and cooling time, and calibrate infrared emissivity. Retain temperature histories at different depths, verify sensor response time, and use initial-to-final energy balance to check mean temperature rise.
units.failure: 局部接觸不均會產生熱點，即使平均溫升不高仍可能形成熱裂紋；錯誤放射率也會掩蓋真實表面溫度。 若表面與內部溫差很大，集中熱容量假設便不足。~Uneven contact can create hot spots and thermal cracks despite a modest mean rise; incorrect emissivity can also conceal the actual surface temperature. A large surface-to-core temperature difference indicates that the lumped thermal-capacity assumption is insufficient.
units.misconception: 煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點~A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots.
units.practice: 將同一能量分給兩種有效熱容量，計算平均溫升後設計能辨認熱點的量測網格，說明集中參數模型缺少哪些資訊。 再以本單元 energy 的對照值重算 rise，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Allocate equal energy to two effective thermal capacities, calculate average rise, and design a measurement grid for hot spots while identifying information missing from the lumped model. Also recalculate rise for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

教學假設，單元 3：train_area=9.54 m^2，計算 displacement_flow=190.8 m^3/s；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 3: train_area=9.54 m^2, calculated displacement_flow=190.8 m^3/s; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 4：v=74.2 m/s，計算 distance=4118.1 m；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 4: v=74.2 m/s, calculated distance=4118.1 m; not measured performance.
